deliverables.next_question: The fixed routing matrix does not beat the cheap STRATUM_QUERY control. The remaining high-confidence state errors are concentrated in reminder length6 local invalidation/old-source revival, while NO_PRIOR worsens results. The next controlled study should share the exact initial adapter parameters and provide counterfactual local process feedback for evidence invalidation/no-new-evidence old-source resurrection, recording actual parameter updates and a matched control; it should not default to larger groups, higher lambda, or more sampling loops.

answers_A_F.A: No. TEMP_CONF did not exceed STRATUM_QUERY on N_same length6: s11 +0.09375 CI[-0.21875,0.25], s23 -0.2265625 CI[-0.828125,0.2265625], adapter mean -0.06640625 CI[-0.451171875,0.236328125], n=256; all CIs cover zero.
answers_A_F.B: It exceeds ARGMAX/RAW (adapter mean +1.2832 CI[+0.6797,+1.9023] and +0.6738 CI[+0.2227,+1.2070]) but not STRATUM_QUERY. This is an engineering fallback benefit, not evidence that calibration adds value over the cheap stratum rule.
answers_A_F.C: Calibration is not all-query (TEMP query ~0.50) and improves NLL, but high-confidence errors remain: s11 raw/temp >=.975 errors 3/1 of 4 wrong; s23 10/3 of 17 wrong. State accuracy is unchanged, and s23 J NLL worsens (0.016709 to 0.032019), so temperature transfer is not uniformly reliable. The state prediction itself is wrong in those cases; no workflow gate or new model was added.
answers_A_F.D: No. Removing the prior segment worsens utility and state accuracy: aggregate delta -3.046875, CI[-4.417969,-1.828125], n=128; per-adapter state accuracy s11 .969->.883, s23 .867->.797. Prior labels are useful here; old-source revival is not explained by redundant prior display.
answers_A_F.E: N_same main shows no TEMP>STRATUM advantage; N_new length6 does favor TEMP (mean 8.699 vs 6.723) but is secondary wording transfer; J is high overall (TEMP 9.410, ARGMAX 9.492, STRATUM 9.248) and s23 J NLL worsens. Conclusions are limited to representation/wording; views are not pooled.
answers_A_F.F: The new-test original SFT remains strong on length4 and J; N_same length6 ARGMAX is 8.891 (s11) and 6.910 (s23). The old failure scope is narrower than a blanket failure story; no harder samples were selected to preserve a narrative.
